description: This repository contains experimental data from optical trapping measurements conducted at laser powers of 130 mW and 260 mW. The dataset includes results for actin and vimentin filaments under various velocity conditions. Each data file name encodes the velocity condition under which it was recorded (For example: number-vX.h5, where vX represents the specific velocity (e.g., v1, v2, etc.)). Each dataset is named according to the corresponding velocity condition used during the experiment. Actin Data: All actin measurements were collected at a laser power of 130 mW. Vimentin Data: All vimentin measurements are organized in the respective folders for each figure presented in the manuscript. The laser power used for each velocity condition is specified in the README file within each respective folder. Experimental Parameters: Conversion Factors (um/v): 130 mW: 1.88 260 mW: 0.91 Trap Stiffness (pN/nm): 130 mW: 0.24 260 mW: 0.5 All measurements were taken under consistent calibration settings.

distribution.name: Figure_2.zip
distribution.description:
This folder contains the active microrheology data presented in Figure 2 (c, d) of the manuscript.
Each subfolder includes datasets for both vimentin and actin filaments.

Panels (a, b) in the figure represent a single example dataset corresponding to the file ending with v5.h5.

The vimentin folder includes data collected under different laser power conditions:
v1, v2, and v5 were recorded at a laser power of 130 mW.
v10 and v11 were recorded at a laser power of 260 mW.

distribution.name: Figure_3.zip
distribution.description:
This folder contains the active microrheology data presented in Figure 3 of the manuscript.
For vimentin in panel (c), the data were taken from Figure 2, where the extension phase lasts for 1 s.
while for actin, the data in this folder were used, and only the first 1 s of the extension phase was analyzed.
Panel (d) represents the analysis of the data provided in the panel (b) folder.
The data in (c) is also used for Figure S8.
